title: India's Cockroach Party denounces crumbling schools: 'Children are treated worse than animals'
subhead: Founded just a few months ago, the Cockroach Janta Party, a Gen Z-led movement, has visited several schools and conducted an audit to expose the extent of their dilapidation and unsanitary conditions. title: The story of Paris's 'cursed' island
subhead: On October 17, Le Large will open its doors – a small miracle given the many projects that have fallen through after Renault left Seguin Island, just west of Paris, in 1992. But the story is not over: The center of the island remains conspicuously empty.

title: Where to live? How climate change is forcing us to rethink our relationship with our surroundings
subhead: Excessive heat, water shortages, rising sea levels: A place's habitability depends first and foremost on physical thresholds. But it also depends on the relationship between a space and the people who live there, which plays a key role in how people adapt to climate change.
